labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Requests a wider type for Table title, which is new behaviour rather than a defect.

body:
This is a feature request. Rich asks that new features are approved in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue is opened, so please start there if you want to pursue it.

The table title is drawn as a text annotation, so it only accepts `str` or `Text` at the moment. For the layout you describe, [`Table.grid`](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst) is the documented layout tool and can hold a `Rule` and a table together. A closely related earlier request, #4171, was closed as not planned.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
